events.title: Intra-Trademark Opposition Competition Final Rounds
events.description: A first-of-its-kind adversarial exercise simulating trademark opposition proceedings before the Trade Marks Registry. Participants will represent the Opponent or Applicant in a hypothetical trademark dispute and argue their case entirely through oral advocacy, without written submissions or memorials. The competition will test participants' understanding of trademark law, procedural knowledge, and advocacy skills.

events.title: Call for Submission for Comments on Draft Guidelines for Registration of Designs Relating to GUI & ICONS
events.description:
Ever wondered how app screens, icons and interfaces should be protected under design law? 

The CGPDTM (DPIIT) has invited public comments on the Draft Guidelines for Registration of Designs Relating to GUI, Icons, etc., and IPR Cell of GLC Mumbai wants your voice in it!

Submission Deadline: 12 PM | 19 October, 2026.
